correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of all 2^20 vertex subsets under the closed-neighborhood predicate yields 434220 nonempty faces. A deterministic 217103-pair discrete-Morse matching is exhaustively acyclic by processing all 434220 vertices of the 3663080-arrow oriented Hasse graph, leaving one 0-cell and 13 cells in dimension 9; this establishes the integral homotopy wedge. Signed simplicial Lefschetz calculations on all fixed-simplex orbit unions give the claimed ten-character vector, which decomposes as trivial(1), sign(4), faithful cyclotomic(2). A distinct bipartite Petersen-cover model independently reproduces the graph and f-vector. Full certificate executable is included.

value.rationale: The dominance complex is a standard natural graph-topology invariant. The Desargues graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic 20-vertex graph, beyond the family calculations in the motivating 2023 source. The complete integral wedge type and full C10 character provide a nontrivial and symmetry-sensitive classification distinct from the already studied independence/matching/cut topologies of the same graph; not a renamed known formula or an arbitrary numeric slice.
